name: Break-even effect
fact: The break-even effect occurs when individuals, having experienced prior losses, find outcomes that offer a chance to break even particularly attractive.

provenance.title: Gambling with the House Money and Trying to Break Even: The Effects of Prior Outcomes on Risky Choice
provenance.quote_or_locus: break-even effects” (in the presence of prior losses, outcomes which offer a chance to break even are especially attractive
